title: Emergency upgrade: the 14-day amendment wait is too slow, and an enabled amendment cannot be rolled back
severity_reason: A DefaultYes critical fix needs the full 14-day hold (enabled day 14.0207) — too slow for an active exploit, so the emergency path is a binary upgrade; 5 validators never upgraded and became amendment-blocked. The rollback attempt failed (1 attempt, 1 failure): no in-protocol path exists. Per-node replay of 100 ledgers re-executed history without changing the enabled amendment.

title: Quorum failure: chain halts, and a 65.7% minority gains amendment majority during the outage
severity_reason: 12 validators offline for 5 days: 108,000 ledgers missed (chain halts, 23 online < quorum 24). During the outage the threshold denominator shrank to the 23 validations received (threshold 15), so the 23-vote minority gained majority on day 5.0119; on recovery the bar returned to 24 and the majority was lost on day 10.0119 after holding 5.0 days — 1 restart, never enabled.

title: Majority-time override: an operator can shrink the 14-day hold to 15 minutes
severity_reason: AMENDMENT_MAJORITY_TIME overridden to the 15-minute minimum: fixExample enabled day 0.0237 (34 minutes) instead of day 14.0207 — the hold collapsed 14 days -> 15 minutes (1344x shorter) and end-to-end enablement was 591x faster, with no network-wide check that the hold was shortened.

title: Veto deadlock: a blocking minority vetoes an amendment with 30/35 support
severity_reason: 12 vetoes cut support 30 -> 18 on day 3 (majority lost after holding 3.0 days); one un-veto raised it to 19, still below the 24-vote bar; the amendment never enabled over 21 days. unknownFeature has no code and never entered voting (effectively vetoed).

title: Treasury and fee controls: no treasury exists; a split fee vote changes nothing
severity_reason: No treasury control exists (0 hits in code, 0 in the whitepaper) — fee votes are the only economic control. The fee vote split 12/12/11 across 10/12/15 drops with target 12: the 15-drop votes fell outside [current, target] and were discarded, the 10/12 tie kept the fee at 10 drops; 0 fee changes.

title: Majority-loss clock restart: a 2-hour dip costs 12 days
severity_reason: Majority held 12.0 days, then a dip to 22/35 support for one flag-ledger interval lost the majority; the 14-day clock restarted and the amendment enabled day 26.1207 — 12.1 days later than the day-14.0207 baseline. A ~2-hour dip cost the 12 banked days.

title: Amendment-blocked divergence: 5 validators on old binaries lose vote and validation, shrinking the safety margin
severity_reason: 5 validators on old binaries became amendment-blocked when fixExample enabled (day 14.0207): they cannot validate or vote. The network kept validating (30 online >= quorum 24) and fixSecond still enabled (day 34.0207, threshold 20 at 30 validations — the denominator shrank again), but the safety margin shrank from 11 to 6 validators.

title: Compromised validator key: manifest rotation recovers a signing key, revocation removes a master key
severity_reason: V07 signing-key compromise recovered by 1 manifest rotation (sequence 1 -> 2) with no validation interruption. V11 master-key compromise required 1 revocation manifest (sequence 0xFFFFFFFF); the validator left the UNL (35 -> 34) and the quorum recomputed 24 -> 23.

title: Validator-set churn: publisher loss disables quorum, negative UNL lowers it, exclusion applies gradually
severity_reason: One publisher down: quorum held at 24. Two of three down: quorum disabled for 84 flag ledgers and 21,600 ledgers missed until a publisher returned. 3 unreliable validators lowered the effective UNL to 32 and the quorum to 22. One exclusion (24/35 agreement) applied at one change per 10 ledgers.

title: Fee-vote split: reserve change stalls on a near-tie and silent validators count as no-votes
severity_reason: Owner-reserve vote split 18 for the current 2 XRP against 17 for 5 XRP: the modal value is current, so the reserve did not move. Base-fee vote: 18 submitted a fee field, 17 counted as noVote; the fee stayed at 10 drops. 0 fee changes.

title: Baseline: full governance stack under normal conditions
severity_reason: Baseline control: 30/35 support, threshold 23, majority day 0.0119, enabled day 14.0207 after the full 14-day hold; quorum 24; 324,000/324,000 ledgers validated, 0 missed; base fee unchanged at 10 drops.
